public_rationale: Firsthand reports show that mistakes spoiled some outputs and required correction. Other contemporaneous tests found substantial practical benefits. These findings can coexist: useful agents can still lose considerable utility to errors. The available records establish examples of the mechanism, but do not settle the broad magnitude claimed.
limitations: The causal evidence consists of small, selected task demonstrations.
No retrieved study estimates the total utility lost to errors during the target period.
Positive examples are counterweight, not a direct contradiction of a substantial limitation.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Mistakes and errors have greatly limited the utility of agents like ChatGPT agent.

statement.excerpt: In practice, those mistakes and errors have greatly limited the utility agents like ChatGPT agent.
statement.document_title: AI Agents have, so far, mostly been a dud

our_interpretation: The plain reading is that errors substantially reduced usable task completion or imposed substantial checking and correction work.
The claim does not require agents to be useless, or errors to be the sole or largest limitation.
ChatGPT agent is the named example. Assess its introduction-to-publication period, July 17 through August 3, 2025; evidence about earlier agents is background.
Distinguish model mistakes from deliberate approval requirements, access restrictions, outages and slow execution.
criteria.support_condition: Task evaluations or deployment records directly connect errors to substantial loss of usable results or substantial correction burdens across ordinary uses.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records show that errors caused little practical loss of utility, with usable completion and correction burdens largely unaffected.

evidence.explanation: The firsthand account links failed execution and inaccurate outputs to unusable or repair-needing results in several tasks. It supports the proposed mechanism, but does not quantify the overall utility lost because of errors.

This firsthand review found practical benefits in shopping, planning and administrative tasks. It is material positive evidence, but usefulness in selected tasks does not measure or disprove the loss attributable to errors.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Contemporaneous task or deployment records measuring successful usable outputs, checking and repair time, and failure causes across representative uses of ChatGPT agent and comparable agents.
